question: 如果我的血压现在是高（分低/中/高三档），把每周运动量从「少」增加到「多」（分少/中/多三档），血压能从高变到中或低吗？

operationalization_hints.measurement: minutes of moderate-to-vigorous activity per week

must_not_infer.reason: Collapsing categorical exercise_amount to a bool 'exercises_more=True' drops the user's explicit three-level framing and makes the 少→多 contrast inexpressible as a single intervention value.

ambiguities.description: Question names two specific category values for the intervention (from=少, to=多) and asks about the target transition (from=高 to 中/低). Naive extraction may record only the predicate and drop the level-pair framing.
ambiguities.expected_behavior: preserve the 少→多 intervention contrast and the 高→{中,低} target contrast either in the query or in extensions; don't silently bool-ify
